Both pnpm 8 and 10 need it."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The repository ships its build output (`lib/`) and has no `prepare` script, so pnpm runs no build sc"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ript when installing from a git source and you never have to grant `allowBuilds`."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"If you run harness from source, replace both `dsh` commands above with `pnpm dsh` inside the harness"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"harness from source, replace both `dsh` commands above with `pnpm dsh` inside the harness directory."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### Uninstall"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Skins installed through the market do not disappear with it — they are independent dependencies in t"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"he profile, uninstalled individually from the market's Installed tab."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**Browsing** needs only dsh and a network. **Installing** is what needs the command-line tools, beca"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"use installing is fundamentally running `pnpm` on your behalf."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Dependency | Requirement | What happens without it |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| **DeepSeek Harness** | `0.1.0-rc.6+` (tested on rc.7) | Earlier versions lack `settings.section` a"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"nd the browser module table, so the plugin cannot mount |
| **profile** | Must be the **web** profil"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"e | headless / tui bundles have no `webServer`, so the plugin never activates |
| **Node.js** | `>= "},{"id":"p27s4","text":"20` (tested on 24) | dsh's own requirement; the plugin does not raise it |
| **pnpm** | On `PATH` (t"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"ested on 8.15 and 10) | Affects installing only. Diagnostics flags it red and the install button rep"},{"id":"p27s6","text":"orts a clear error, while browsing and search continue |
| **git** | Only for GitHub-source skins | "},{"id":"p27s7","text":"Most catalog skins now use Release tarballs (no git needed); only a few remain `github:owner/repo` s"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"ources |
| **Network** | `dsh.a2hmarket.ai`; also `github.com` for GitHub-source skins | An unreacha"},{"id":"p27s9","text":"ble registry falls back to the cache or bundled snapshot, and the page says so |
| **Browser** | Ins"},{"id":"p27s10","text":"talling requires a **direct local connection** (loopback) | Remote access can browse and search; ins"},{"id":"p27s11","text":"talling is refused |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The plugin itself has a single runtime dependency: `yaml`, used to read and write the profile's patc"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"gin itself has a single runtime dependency: `yaml`, used to read and write the profile's patch file."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"No configuration is needed by default. To change something, append a section to the profile's `cordi"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"s.patch.yml` (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`) overriding this plugin's row by id:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"After changing code, run `pnpm build` again and restart dsh. When the plugin is installed into a pro"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"file with `link:`, there is no need to `add` it again."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"**`lib/` is committed on purpose**: pnpm does not run build scripts for git sources by default, so a"},{"id":"p35s2","text":" package without build output is missing its entry file and stops dsh from starting. Commit the `pnp"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"m build` output along with your code changes."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"### The two halves"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"| | File | Responsibility |"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"| host | `src/index.ts` | Mounts `/skin-market/api/*` on `ctx.webServer`: catalog proxy and cache, i"},{"id":"p38s2","text":"nstalled list, install/uninstall (streaming pnpm output over SSE), diagnostics |
| client | `src/cli"},{"id":"p38s3","text":"ent/index.ts` | Registers `settings.section`, renders the list, search and install interactions |"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"The two halves talk over **same-origin HTTP** rather than `ctx.remote` — the remote capability set i"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"s fixed at `api-remotes` build time and third-party plugins cannot add to it."},{"id":"p40s1","text":"`lib/client.js` is CJS in closure-factory form (`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })`); ex"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"ternal dependencies such as React come from the host-injected `require` via the module table and are"},{"id":"p40s3","text":" not bundled. That shape is dictated by dsh's module table, and `tsdown.config.ts` reproduces it."},{"id":"p41s1","text":"### Harness types"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"`types/dsh.d.ts` vendors the parts of the harness API we use, transcribed from the 0.1.0-rc.7 source"},{"id":"p42s2","text":" with the origin noted at each site — these modules are all external at runtime, and the `@deepseek-"},{"id":"p42s3","text":"ai/dsh-client-*` dependency chain on npm is currently incomplete and cannot be installed. When host "},{"id":"p42s4","text":"behaviour disagrees with the declarations, check that file first."},{"id":"p43s1","text":"## Related"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"| dsh.a2hmarket.ai | The skin catalog site where authors publish.
